passages.text: Chants, recitations, fine sayings, or charity of woven rugs: if by means of any such things you benefit, then by all means keep doing them. But if you understand that ‘this good thing can’t be had by me or by anyone else’, you should accept it without sorrowing, thinking: ‘The deed is powerful. What can I do now?’
passages.note: Accepting a loss that nothing can undo
